prompt.project_info: Create a candid glamour mirror selfie in an aesthetic nightclub restroom.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with sleek wet-look or loose-wave hair, dewy natural skin, cherry-red lip gloss, and confident gaze, wearing an opaque black satin knee-length slip-inspired dress with secure straps and layered gold chains.
prompt.composition_elements: Subject leans naturally against a marble sink while holding a small clutch and phone, ornate mirror with water droplets, red or pink neon reflection, marble countertop, lipstick or drink glass, and no body-part emphasis.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Moody red-pink neon ambient glow plus phone flash, deep cinematic shadows, realistic mirror smudge and hand motion, late-night mysterious mood.
prompt.technical_specs: 9:16 vertical smartphone mirror selfie, high-contrast flash, realistic lip gloss and satin texture, digital grain in shadows, high-fidelity lighting.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: An approved adult woman with sleek wet-look hair or effortless loose waves takes a candid mirror selfie in a dim nightclub restroom. She has dewy natural skin, cherry-red lip gloss, and a confident gaze. She wears an opaque black satin knee-length slip-inspired dress with secure straps and layered thin gold chains, holding a small clutch and phone while leaning naturally against a marble sink. Include a large ornate mirror with water droplets, red or pink neon reflection, marble countertop, and optional lipstick or drink glass. Use moody red-pink neon plus phone flash, deep cinematic shadows, realistic satin and gloss texture, mirror smudge, digital grain, and no readable branding.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, backless mini dress, thin spaghetti straps, exposed back, cleavage emphasis, seductive hip twist, sexualized expression, nudity, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, public figure likeness.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required environment reference. Preserve approved-adult identity, restroom, mirror, neon red-pink palette, flash, marble, hair, and satin mood; replaceable elements are clutch, lipstick, and sign design. Keep clothing opaque and typography unverified or absent.

changes: Replaced backless mini dress, exposed-back/cleavage emphasis, and seductive hip twist with an opaque knee-length dress and natural sink-leaning pose.
